science.qualification: Shared neutral gray display convention for a planet with no image or measured color in this package; a sphere of the published radius, lit by its own star, whose measured color (#ffc282, the color dataset of lhs-1678 (src/objects/lhs-1678/source/photometry/stellar-color.json)) tints the gray at the same brightness.

metadata.limbMeaning: The adopted source-radius opaque-sphere silhouette and prepared phase lighting define the limb; no atmospheric rim is inferred.
